I1.title: `Seats.tla`: a principal holds one seat, and a seat's kind bounds what it may do. Two invariants, each broken by its own mutation: checked by TLC, proved by TLAPS and in Lean

I2.title: `RunSeats.tla`: in Run, only a thinker seat actuates and an observer seat consults and reports, and no variant name is shared by Build and Run. Three invariants, each with the mutations that break it: checked by TLC, proved by TLAPS and in Lean

I3.title: `FloorComposition.tla`: nothing is admitted without a clean floor permit, whatever the bundle says, and the bundle cannot write what the floor reads. Five invariants, each with the mutations that break it: checked by TLC, proved by TLAPS and in Lean

I4.title: `FloorRouting.tla`: a floor that permits anything its predecessor did not is never deployed without an anchor issuance, and the deployed floor never permits everything. Two invariants, each with the mutation that breaks it: checked by TLC, proved by TLAPS and in Lean

I5.title: `RulesFloorNV_rev5.tla`: every rules-floor entry is non-vacuous against ADR-0024 revision 5, and each property holds with its entry in force. Six invariants, each broken by dropping its entry: checked by TLC, proved by TLAPS and in Lean, and **not certified**

I6.title: `RulesFloorBase.tla`: the live definition of the rules floor, its six entries and the genesis rules that satisfy it, shared by the bootstrap modules. Definitions only: no TLC run and no proof module of its own; two theorems proved in Lean

I7.title: `Confinement.tla`: an effect counted `Contained` ran inside the archetype profile, at every rung a deployment may declare, and what each rung trusts the host with. Four invariants: checked by TLC at rungs 0 to 3, proved by TLAPS and in Lean, and **not certified**

I8.title: `Confinement_A1.tla`: the successor that carries ADR-0034 finding 6. One definition changes, rung 0 becomes a row of the module, and nothing checked at rungs 1 to 3 moves: checked by TLC at rungs 0 to 3, proved by TLAPS and in Lean, and **not certified**

I9.title: `ConfinementRefinement.tla`: the reference's own confinement states, mapped onto `Confinement_A1.tla` and held to four of its invariants at every recorded step. Checked by trace validation: 82 traces, 1,007 steps, every one matching

I10.title: `RunConfinement.tla`: every effect admitted under a `Contained` Run lease reached its tool's declared target, through a tool something holds to its channel. Two invariants, each with the mutations that break it: checked by TLC with and without D-0034-5's filter, proved by TLAPS

I11.title: `Lease.tla`: a renewal never adds authority, no action is admitted at a fenced epoch, a revoked principal stays stopped, and rung 0 is never `Contained`. Four invariants, each broken by its mutation: checked by TLC; frozen, and proved only as its successor

I12.title: `Lease_A1.tla`: the lease schema as amended by A1. A renewal keeps the confinement rung, so a principal never leaves `Contained` silently. Four invariants, each broken by its mutation: checked by TLC at rungs 0 to 3, proved and certified by TLAPS, and proved in Lean

I13.title: `Labels.tla`: every item of Run's ingress is labelled and delivered clear or as a handle, and the floor refuses an outward call that would carry a secret out after tainted bytes were read, or go where tainted bytes steer it. Ten properties, eight mutations: checked by TLC, proved and certified by TLAPS

I14.title: `ToolList.tla`: the Thinker is told exactly the tools its lease may call, the list is fixed for the round, and the Observer reads the same list. Five properties, four mutations, each breaking exactly what the header says: checked by TLC, proved and certified by TLAPS
